come across: I came across an old friend while shopping in the supermarket yesterday.
我昨天在超市购物时偶然遇见了一位老朋友。
carry on: Carry on with your work, and don't let the noise distract you.
继续做你的工作,不要让噪音分散你的注意力。
sunburnt: After a whole day on the beach, his shoulders were red and sunburnt.
在海滩上待了一整天后,他的肩膀晒得又红又黑。
hybrid: This hybrid car uses both electricity and petrol, so it saves a lot of fuel.
这款混合动力汽车既用电也用汽油,因此节省很多燃料。
disturbing: There was a disturbing piece of news about the flood in the newspaper.
报纸上有一则关于洪水的令人不安的消息。
Vietnam: My uncle traveled to Vietnam last summer and enjoyed the beautiful beaches there.
我叔叔去年夏天去越南旅行,很喜欢那里美丽的海滩。
rid…of: The doctor helped him rid himself of the bad habit of smoking.
医生帮助他戒掉了吸烟的坏习惯。
be satisfied with: The teacher was satisfied with the progress we made in English this term.
老师对我们这学期在英语上取得的进步感到满意。
would rather: I would rather stay at home and read a book than go to the party.
我宁愿待在家里看书,也不愿去参加聚会。
peanut: She is allergic to peanuts, so she never eats food containing peanut oil.
她对花生过敏,所以从不吃含花生油的食物。
build up: Regular exercise can help you build up your strength and stay healthy.
经常锻炼能帮助你增强体质,保持健康。
lead to: Eating too much sugar can lead to serious health problems.
吃太多糖会导致严重的健康问题。
focus on: Please turn off your phone and focus on your study for the next hour.
请关掉手机,在接下来的一小时里专注于学习。
keep…free of: Washing your hands often can help keep them free of germs.
勤洗手有助于让双手不受细菌侵害。
keep…free from: We should keep the river free from pollution to protect the fish.
我们应该让河流免受污染,以保护鱼类。
punchline: He told a long joke, but I didn't understand the punchline at all.
他讲了一个很长的笑话,但我完全没听懂其中的妙语。
Charlie Chaplin: Charlie Chaplin was famous for his silent films and his funny little moustache.
查理·卓别林以他的无声电影和有趣的小胡子而闻名。
Edward Lear: Edward Lear wrote many funny poems that children still enjoy reading today.
爱德华·李尔写了许多有趣的诗歌,孩子们至今仍喜欢阅读。
Victor Hugo: Victor Hugo wrote some of the greatest novels in French literature.
维克多·雨果写出了法国文学中最伟大的一些小说。
up to now: Up to now, we have learned more than one thousand English words.
到现在为止,我们已经学了一千多个英语单词。
feel content with: After a good meal, he felt content with his simple life.
吃了一顿好饭,他对自己简朴的生活感到满足。
be content with: Don't be content with what you have achieved; keep working hard.
不要满足于已取得的成绩,要继续努力。
astonishing: The magician showed us an astonishing trick that nobody could explain.
魔术师给我们表演了一个谁也解释不了的惊人戏法。
badly off: His family was badly off, so he had to leave school and find a job.
他家境贫困,所以不得不辍学去找工作。
teens: She learned to play the piano in her early teens.
她在十几岁刚出头时就学会了弹钢琴。
worn: He wore a worn jacket to school because he couldn't afford a new one.
他穿着一件旧夹克上学,因为他买不起新的。
worn-out: These worn-out shoes hurt my feet, so I need to buy a new pair.
这双破旧的鞋弄疼了我的脚,所以我得买双新的。
stiffly: After sitting for hours, the old man stood up and walked stiffly.
坐了几个小时后,老人站起来,走路很僵硬。
underdog: The team was the underdog, but they won the game in the end.
这支球队本来处于劣势,但最终赢得了比赛。
pick out: Can you pick out the correct answer from these four choices?
你能从这四个选项中挑出正确答案吗?
star in: She will star in a new film about a brave young teacher.
她将主演一部关于一位勇敢的年轻教师的新电影。
Oscar: The actress won an Oscar for her wonderful performance in the film.
这位女演员因在影片中的精彩表演获得了奥斯卡奖。
Garcia: Mr. Garcia teaches us Spanish and often tells stories about his hometown.
加西亚先生教我们西班牙语,经常讲他家乡的故事。
Colombia: Colombia is a South American country famous for its coffee and flowers.
哥伦比亚是南美洲的一个国家,以咖啡和鲜花闻名。
defend against: The vaccine helps the body defend against the flu virus.
这种疫苗能帮助身体抵御流感病毒。
Akira Nagata: Akira Nagata invited me to join the Japanese club after class.
课后,永田明邀请我加入日语社团。
Ahmed Aziz: Ahmed Aziz moved from Egypt to our school and quickly made many friends.
艾哈迈德·阿齐兹从埃及转学到我们学校,很快交了许多朋友。
Jordan: Jordan is a country in West Asia with a long and rich history.
约旦是西亚的一个国家,历史悠久,文化丰富。
Darlene Coulon: Darlene Coulon, our new French teacher, speaks English very well.
达琳·库隆,我们的新法语老师,英语说得非常好。
Muslim: His Muslim friend does not eat pork and prays five times a day.
他的穆斯林朋友不吃猪肉,每天祈祷五次。
